scenes.title: Three Stones North
scenes.summary: At dawn on Saturday before the upstairs guests wake, Mina, Junho, and Sungmin count three flat flagstones north from the courtyard shade tree.

scenes.title: Wrapped in Waxed Cloth
scenes.summary: Sora brings hot morning coffee from the kitchen just as Junho lifts the third stone and uncovers a dry parcel wrapped in heavy waxed cloth.

scenes.title: The Biscuit Tin
scenes.summary: Inside sunlit Room 9, Mina, Sora, and Sungmin untie the waxed cloth to reveal a painted red-and-gold biscuit tin sealed thirty summers ago.

scenes.title: The Brass Compass
scenes.summary: Junho eases open the stiff tin lid with a drop of oil, and he and Mina discover a shining brass pocket compass resting on top.

scenes.title: Four Illustrated Cards
scenes.summary: Room 4 guest Youngmi and architect Jihoon examine four watercolour clue cards from the tin, and Jihoon recognises the signature mark of his retired cartography professor.

scenes.title: Half of a Cake Recipe
scenes.summary: In the café corner, Sora, Youngmi, and Minsu read a neatly torn card holding only the top half of the famous summer berry-and-almond cake recipe.

scenes.title: Five Young Friends
scenes.summary: Sungmin, Youngmi, and Jihoon admire a thirty-year-old charcoal sketch from the bottom of the tin showing five smiling friends around a courtyard table.

scenes.title: Walk All Four Clues First
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Mina, Junho, and Jihoon inspect a small wax-sealed envelope instructing them to walk all four neighbourhood clues along Eunhaeng Lane before breaking the seal.
